messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(Only the federal holidays that create a three‑day stretch are shown; provincial/territorial holidays that fall on a weekday are omitted for brevity.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of week | Long‑weekend span |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Mon | Jan 1 – 3 |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, etc.) | Feb 20 | Mon | Feb 20 – 22 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Fri | Apr 7 – 9 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Mon | May 22 – 24 |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Sat (observed Mon Jul 3) | Jul 1 – 3 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Mon | Sep 4 – 6 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Mon | Oct 9 – 11 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Fri | Nov 11 – 13 |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Mon | Dec 25 – 27 |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tue | Dec 26 – 27 |

**Quick notes**

* If a holiday falls on a weekend, the day off is usually observed on the following Monday (e.g., Canada Day 2023 was on Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday, July 3).  
* Provincial holidays such as Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day, or others may add additional long weekends in specific regions.  
* The “long‑weekend span” column shows the full stretch of days that are typically off work (including the weekend and the holiday itself).

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app!
